decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reasons for Refusal

1.	The proposed nine unit flat development by reason of its' size, scale, positioning and three-storey design would unduly dominate the immediate street scene and would be out of character with the design and scale of the surrounding residential development on Main, which is considered contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.




2.	The proposed development would exceed the maximum density level identified in the UDP and would represent an over-development of the site to the detriment of the surrounding area.  It is therefore considered contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.4.2 (Residential Density) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003

3.	The proposed nine-unit flat development would not be provided with a suitably sized communal amenity space, to the detriment of the amenity of the occupiers of the units and would therefore be contrary with policy H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Demolition of existing house and erection of 8 two bedroom flats and 1 one bedroom flat with associated parking and landscaping
